knowledge_notes: Attachment-only research for existing Sweden statistics; no public page, map or other country is changed. The existing public entry remains inherited_unreviewed.

The quoted PTS reply is dated 7 September 2026, while the outer follow-up email is dated 14 September. Neither establishes the public heading Statistics from 2026-09-09. All four PDFs carry export timestamps on 7 September; report-title dates (3 September for complaints and 21 May for deficiencies) are not established data cutoffs.

Local contents and arithmetic were checked. unverified_source reflects the existing schema restriction on correspondence-only evidence, not a finding that the supplied figures are false. No external retrieval or new general Sweden research was performed.

The requester asked for company totals, but PTS explicitly answered in reports. PTS said statistics were unavailable for questions 3 (companies not stating compliance), 6 (planned cases not started) and 8 (cases meeting documentation requirements); this does not mean zero.
The 14 September follow-up asks for names of companies in active cases; no answer is present. The deficiency-report list must not be substituted for a list of active enforcement cases.

The earlier 124 complaints / 110 services / 14 products assertion and other monitoring assertions are outside this pass. Requests and invitations in the email are evidence context, not instructions to contact anyone.

attempts.scope: Read the supplied email and four PDFs to trace the six existing September statistics claims.
attempts.limitations: Local files only; no original MIME attachments or public URLs. Counted 535 dated rows across 32 pages, but did not manually audit every organisation or derive unique-company/sector counts. Source review remained within the ten-minute country budget.
attempts.next_check: Resolve date and sector qualifiers before public edits; obtain public primary provenance or a separately authorised correspondence-policy decision before verified status.
